references.title: Course material status screen
references.question: Q5
references.take: The Teachable course editor result is a direct status-oriented material screen, useful for locating publish or availability state near course content.

references.title: Course content visibility screen
references.question: Q5
references.take: Kajabi appears in the visibility-focused course material search, offering a comparable place to surface content availability controls.

references.title: Learner course resource view
references.question: Q6
references.take: Skillshare is returned for a learner resource list query, making it a useful learner-side reference for course structure and resource access.

references.title: Learner resources and preview
references.question: Q6
references.take: Coursera is returned for a student resource list with download and preview, grounding learner-side access patterns.

references.title: Learner course materials
references.question: Q6
references.take: SuperHi appears in the student resources search and provides an additional learner-side course materials comparison.

references.title: Course lesson resources
references.question: Q6
references.take: Podia is surfaced for a lesson with learner availability and downloadable resources, useful for connecting lesson structure to access.

references.title: Setting status for lesson
references.question: Q5
references.take: Squarespace shows a five-step lesson status flow, evidence that visibility can be handled as an explicit editing sequence rather than a passive label.

references.title: Adding a drip
references.question: Q5
references.take: Teachable’s drip flow indicates scheduled lesson availability can be configured through a dedicated multi-step interaction.

references.title: Updating visibility
references.question: Q5
references.take: Podia provides a compact three-screen visibility update flow, showing availability as an intentional edit action.

references.title: Watching a video
references.question: Q6
references.take: Codecademy’s learner video flow supplies a concrete example of consuming course media within a structured lesson journey.
